description: Fixed signer-disjoint split of BdSLW60 for reproducible benchmarking. Train/val/test contain only signers who recorded the full 60-word vocabulary; partial-coverage signers are routed to a pretraining pool.

notes.partial_tiny_assignment_rule: Signers who recorded fewer than all 60 classes are excluded from train/val/test and routed to 'pretrain' so label distributions remain balanced; they form an unlabeled pool for self-supervised pretraining.
